verdict.rationale: Elastic's marketing page claims users can interact with their telemetry through natural language, and ES|QL is the documented query language, so the core NL-to-telemetry interaction is claimed. Nothing shows the natural-language interface returning a real ES|QL or PromQL query or a chart. Missing for 10: documented NL-to-query (ES|QL/PromQL) generation, NL-to-chart/visualization output, in-depth first-party docs beyond a marketing line, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
Query them with ES|QL or Prometheus Query Language (PromQL), visualize them
